info.title: pm-api — Polymarket x402 paid API
info.description: x402-protocol v2 paid API over the pm-collector Polymarket snapshot archive. Free: GET /health. Paid (USDC, scheme "exact"): GET /v1/polymarket/odds ($0.005 = 5,000 atomic USDC), GET /v1/polymarket/disagreement ($0.02 = 20,000), GET /v1/polymarket/package ($2.00 = 2,000,000, one-time purchase). Unauthenticated paid calls return HTTP 402 with an x402 payment challenge; pay per the challenge and retry with the X-PAYMENT header.
info.x-guidance: Polymarket odds snapshot API. GET /health is free. Paid endpoints use the x402 protocol (USDC on Base, scheme exact): GET /v1/polymarket/odds ($0.005/call, query params limit and q), GET /v1/funding/current ($0.001/call, Hyperliquid per-coin funding snapshot, query param limit), GET /v1/polymarket/disagreement ($0.02/call), GET /v1/polymarket/package ($2.00 one-time purchase per market, query param market required). Unauthenticated calls return HTTP 402 with an x402 v2 payment challenge; pay it and retry with the X-PAYMENT header.

get.description: Returns the literal text "ok" with 200 when the server is up (axum handler returns &str "ok", pm-api src/lib.rs:690).
Serves this OpenAPI 3.1 document (self-describing). Added for x402scan discovery; x402scan's spec fetches GET {origin}/openapi.json.

x402-paid (V2Eip155Exact, 5,000 atomic USDC = $0.005; pm-api src/lib.rs:83,691-703). Latest pm-collector Polymarket snapshot rows, volume-ranked, filtered/limited in Gamma order (lib.rs:478-495). Without a valid X-PAYMENT header the middleware answers HTTP 402 with the x402 payment challenge (x402Version 2, accepts[0] scheme "exact").

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max rows. Default 25, hard cap 200; non-numeric or negative -> 400 (lib.rs:461-473,498-500).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the market question (lib.rs:478).

snapshot_file.description: Path of the source snapshot file (server-local).

get.description: x402-paid (V2Eip155Exact, 20,000 atomic USDC = $0.02; pm-api src/lib.rs:85,704-716). Cross-venue disagreement between the latest Polymarket snapshot and live Kalshi markets. Same 402 challenge behavior as /v1/polymarket/odds.

get.summary: One-time purchase: full attested data package for one market ($2.00)
get.description: x402-paid (V2Eip155Exact, 2,000,000 atomic USDC = $2.00; pm-api src/package.rs:63, src/lib.rs:717-729). One-time purchase, keep the data: full Polymarket attested data package for one market plus a signed license token. Payment settles BEFORE the handler runs (settle_before_execution, lib.rs:683-686).

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Polymarket market slug-or-id, matched exactly, case-insensitive (pm-api src/package.rs:139-145).

404.description: Market not found in the latest snapshot

get.description: x402-paid (V2Eip155Exact, 1,000 atomic USDC = $0.001; pm-api src/lib.rs FUNDING_PRICE_USDC). Latest per-coin Hyperliquid perpetual-funding snapshot read from the read-only sqlite archive var/data/hyperliquid/funding.db (written every tick by jobs/hl-funding-collector): the newest batch only, up to 100 coins ranked by open interest (query param limit, default 100, hard cap 100; non-numeric -> 400). funding_rate is the stored HOURLY rate (signed: positive = longs pay shorts); apr is derived as funding_rate*24*365*100 (annualized %, 4 decimals). Missing/empty DB returns 200 with latest_ts null and status no_data (honest empty body, never fabricated rows); a broken DB is a 503-class funding_db_read_failed 500. Without a valid X-PAYMENT header the middleware answers HTTP 402 with the x402 payment challenge (same behavior as /v1/polymarket/odds).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max coins served, ranked by open interest (desc). Default 100, hard cap 100; non-numeric or negative -> 400.

200.description: Latest funding snapshot, or the honest empty body (latest_ts null, status no_data) when the archive has no data yet.

latest_ts.description: Unix seconds of the newest snapshot batch; null when no data yet.

total_coins.description: Coins present at latest_ts (before limit truncation).

message.description: Present only when status is no_data.

funding_rate.description: Stored Hyperliquid funding rate, per HOUR (signed; positive = longs pay shorts).

apr.description: Annualized percent = funding_rate*24*365*100, rounded to 4 decimals.

yes_prob.description: Probability of the first (usually Yes) outcome in [0,1].

X402PaymentRequired.description: x402 payment challenge (HTTP 402). Body is the x402 v2 PaymentRequired object: { x402Version: 2, error?, resource?, accepts: [...], extensions? } (vendor x402-rs crates/x402-types/src/proto/v2.rs:337-348). Each accepts item carries the USDC payment terms (scheme "exact", network = X402_NETWORK CAIP-2 id, default eip155:84532 Base Sepolia; asset, payTo, maxAmountRequired). Send a signed payment in the X-PAYMENT header and retry the GET.

resource.description: ResourceInfo: url/type/description of the paid resource.

maxAmountRequired.description: Atomic USDC units, e.g. "5000" for odds
